article_manifest.title: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: from the return of the FAMa...
article_manifest.original_title: GOONGA TAN : Kidal : du retour des FAMa...
article_manifest.summary: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: from the return of the FAMa to the Algiers-Abou Dhabi rivalry, is the Sahel entering a new sequence? The entry of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) into Kidal unquestionably marks a major political and military turning point . It enshrines the restoration of a symbol of state authority, modifies the balance of power in the North and shakes up the speeches that, in April, presented the situation as a sign of an irreversible failure of Mali.

article_manifest.title: Assessment of the military operations of the Fama of mid-September 2026: The Dirpa reports 4880 fighters...
article_manifest.original_title: Bilan des opérations militaires des Fama de Mi-Septembre 2026 : La Dirpa fait état de 4880 combattants...
article_manifest.summary: Review of the military operations of the Fama of mid-September 2026: Dirpa reports 4,880 neutralized fighters and more than 162 bases destroyed During its traditional press briefing, held on Friday, October 23, 2026, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (Dirpa) presented the review of the operations conducted by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) between May and September 2026 According to its director, Colonel-Major Boubacar Bocar Maiga, the operations made it possible to neutralize more than 4,880 fighters of the armed groups and to destroy more than 162 bases.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Delivery of a large batch of vehicles to the security forces to strengthen the protection of the territory
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Remise d'un important lot de véhicules aux forces de sécurité pour renforcer la protection du territoire
article_manifest.summary: Placed under the chairmanship of the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, this event testifies to the unwavering desire of the authorities to provide the Armed and Security Forces with adequate logistical means to ensure the security of people and property throughout the national territory This logistical reinforcement includes 75 Toyota pick-up vehicles with single cab assigned to the Directorate General of the National Police and 25 Yamaha brand escort motorcycles assigned to the Directorate General of the National Gendarmerie.

article_manifest.title: AES: regional integration and economic development at the heart of exchanges between leaders
article_manifest.original_title: AES : intégration régionale et développement économique au cœur des échanges entre les dirigeants
article_manifest.summary: The President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, paid a working visit to Burkina Faso and Niger on 5 November 2026. The purpose of this trip was to consolidate relations between the three member countries of the Confederation of Sahelian States AES and to strengthen their cooperation in several areas . In both Ouagadougou and Niamey, discussions focused on security, regional integration and economic development.

article_manifest.title: Dosso: New soldiers of the 2025 contingent of the Agali Training and Education Center presented to the flag
article_manifest.original_title: Dosso : Des nouveaux soldats du contingent 2025 du Centre d’Instruction et d’Enseignement d’Agali présentés au drapeau
article_manifest.summary: Dosso, 6 November (ANP) – The Dosso Training Centre (CIE) hosted this Friday, 6 November 2026, a solemn ceremony of presentation to the national flag of the soldiers of contingent 2025 This major event took place in the presence of many military, administrative, customary and religious authorities of the region, testifying to the importance given to the training and engagement of young recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN) .

article_manifest.title: Mali-Burkina: Assimi Goïta and Ibrahim Traoré strengthen their cooperation
article_manifest.original_title: Mali-Burkina : Assimi Goïta et Ibrahim Traoré renforcent leur coopération
article_manifest.summary: The President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, made an official visit to Burkina Faso on Thursday, November 5, 2026. In Ouagadougou, he was received by the President of Faso and current President of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), Captain Ibrahim Traoré. This is what emerges from the joint communiqué issued at the end of the visit .

article_manifest.original_title: AES : intégration régionale et développement économique au cœur des échanges entre les dirigeants

The purpose of this trip was to consolidate relations between the three member countries of the Confederation of Sahelian States AES and to strengthen their cooperation in several areas . In both Ouagadougou and Niamey, discussions focused on security, regional integration and economic development.

article_manifest.title: Zinder/Defense: Official presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent at the CI/FAN of Aroungouza
article_manifest.original_title: Zinder/Défense : Présentation officielle au drapeau du contingent 2025 au CI/FAN d’Aroungouza
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani Kiaou, presided, on November 4, 2026, at the Zinder Training Center, in Aroungouza, the solemn ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN), in the presence of the Governor of the Zinder region, Colonel Massalatchi Mahaman Sani, as well as several military, administrative and customary officials .

article_manifest.title: Mali: One month after the takeover of Kidal, why the army has not advanced in the region
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Un mois après la reprise de Kidal, pourquoi l'armée n'a plus progressé dans la région
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, it was just a month ago on November 6 that the army and the Africa Corps took over Kidal, in the north. The city had been controlled for nearly six months by the separatists of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and their jihadist allies of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim) While they could be expected to continue their advance in the region, Malian soldiers and their Russian partners are camped, for the time being, on their positions.

article_manifest.title: Burkina: King Gan "officially" declared "dead" four years after his abduction
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina: le roi gan «officiellement» déclaré «mort» quatre ans après son enlèvement
article_manifest.summary: The Gan king of the village of Obiré was declared “officially dead” four years after his abduction, reports Bafujinfo, on Thursday, November 5, 2026. "Kidnapped on September 27, 2022 with his son while they were returning from the field, King Gan of Obiré is now officially declared dead by the sages of the royal court," wrote the regional newspaper of Djôrô which also announces a period of mourning for the entire Gan community since the first funeral started last night while waiting for the big funeral scheduled in three months.

article_manifest.title: Niger: EU calls on Algeria to deploy its troops
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : l'UE interpelle l'Algérie sur le déploiement de ses troupes
article_manifest.summary: At the daily press briefing of the European Commission in Brussels on Friday 30 October 2026, the European Union Spokesperson for Foreign Affairs, Anouar El Anouni, reacted to the sending of Algerian soldiers to Niger. Brussels said it was monitoring the situation closely and asked for clarification on the scope, objective and basis of this operation. .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: 200 new tractors to accelerate agricultural mechanization
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : 200 nouveaux tracteurs pour accélérer la mécanisation agricole
article_manifest.summary: To accelerate the mechanization of Burkina Faso's agriculture, the National Office for Major Projects handed over a large batch of agricultural equipment, mainly tractors, to the Ministry of Agriculture on Friday, November 6, 2026. In total, 200 tractors with a power of 40 horses, accompanied in particular by plows and harrows, were handed over to the department in charge of Agriculture .

article_manifest.title: Mali: one month after the takeover of Kidal, why the army has not advanced in the region
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: un mois après la reprise de Kidal, pourquoi l’armée n’a plus progressé dans la région
article_manifest.summary: Mali: un mois après la reprise de Kidal, pourquoi l’armée n’a plus progressé dans la région Au Mali, cela fait tout juste un mois ce 6 novembre que l'armée et l'Africa Corps ont repris Kidal, dans le Nord. La ville était contrôlée depuis près de six mois par les indépendantistes du Front de libération de l'Azawad (FLA) et leurs alliés jihadistes du Groupe de soutien à l'islam et aux musulmans (Jnim).

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions near Kouakourou and Sofara with precision
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent deux positions terroristes près de Kouakourou et de Sofara avec précision
article_manifest.summary: Thanks to the use of precise intelligence and the coordination of operational means, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) conducted, on Thursday, November 5, 2026, two targeted actions against armed terrorist groups in the Kouakourou and Sofara sectors These interventions illustrate the continuation of efforts to secure the national territory and the determination of the Malian army to prevent any restoration of the operational capacities of terrorist groups.

article_manifest.title: Guinea: "Anarchic" gold panning banned in the north-east, Ouagadougou denounces the eviction of Burkinabe
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée: L'orpaillage «anarchique» interdit dans le nord-est, Ouagadougou dénonce l'expulsion de Burkinabè
article_manifest.summary: In recent days, thousands of gold miners have left the Siguiri region in northeastern Guinea, an area rich in gold that attracts many West African nationals. These mass departures come after the measures taken on 2 November by the Guinean authorities to put an end to illegal gold mining These gold miners, mainly Burkinabe, have found refuge in neighboring Mali, from where their government organizes their repatriation.

article_manifest.title: The terrorism-proof bronze showcase
article_manifest.original_title: La vitrine du bronze à l’épreuve du terrorisme
article_manifest.summary: Bronziers and other artisans in the city of Ouagadougou are thinking about solutions for the sale of their products. The craft sector is hard hit by the consequences of the security crisis in view of the scarcity of tourists. Professionals in the field are developing initiatives and now rest their hopes on Burkinabés.

article_manifest.title: Kouakourou and Sofara: the FAMa strike a base and a terrorist group
article_manifest.original_title: Kouakourou et Sofara : les FAMa frappent une base et un groupe terroriste
article_manifest.summary: As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their allies, continue to carry out actions to secure the territory. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on two strikes carried out on Thursday, November 5, 2026 . 6 kilometers northeast of Kouakourou, precise intelligence identified a terrorist base that housed several fighters, war materials and a fuel depot.

article_manifest.title: The think tank CEDYS calls for a diplomatic approach to defuse tensions between Chad and Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Le think tank CEDYS appelle à privilégier la voie diplomatique pour désamorcer les tensions entre le Tchad et le Niger
article_manifest.summary: In its Policy Brief published in October 2026, entitled "Tensions between Chad and Niger catalyze regional insecurity", the Centre for the Study of Social Dynamics (CEDYS) warns of the risks posed by the growing tensions between N’Djamena and Niamey to the security of the central Sahel Written by Yamingué Betinbaye, Ndilbé Mbaïnguem François and Babouh Tih-Kwada Elisabeth, the document believes that these frictions, fuelled by reciprocal accusations and differences in international alliances, hinder the pooling of efforts in the face of common threats.

article_manifest.summary: - Daba Finance, 5 November 2026 Niger received its first delivery of fuel from Algeria: 53 tankers transported 1.65 million litres of products… More »Niger received its first delivery of fuel from Algeria: 53 tankers transported 1.65 million litres of petroleum products to the city of Agadez, in the north of the country, as it seeks to alleviate fuel shortages and to strengthen its energy cooperation with its northern neighbour.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niger receives 1.65 million litres of Algerian fuel as shortage persists
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Le Niger reçoit 1,65 million de litres de carburant algérien alors que la pénurie persiste
article_manifest.summary: Niger received its first delivery of fuel from Algeria: 53 tankers transported 1.65 million liters of petroleum products to the northern city of Agadez, as the country seeks to alleviate fuel shortages and strengthen its energy cooperation with its northern neighbor . The convoy arrived on October 31, 2026, under military escort from both countries, according to the Nigerien public channel RTN.

article_manifest.title: Sahel: Algeria intensifies its offensive...
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel : l’Algérie intensifie son offensive...
article_manifest.summary: Sahel: Algeria intensifies its diplomatic offensive in Niger and Chad After N'Djamena, the head of Algerian diplomacy went to Niamey to strengthen bilateral relations and promote regional coordination around the security and economic challenges of the Sahel . 06 Nov 2026 - 07:03 1 The Algerian Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Attaf, paid an official visit to Niamey on Wednesday, the day after his visit to Chad.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niger Receives 1.65m Liters of Algerian Fuel As Shortages Persist
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Niger Receives 1.65m Liters of Algerian Fuel As Shortages Persist
article_manifest.summary: Niger has received its first shipment of fuel from Algeria, with 53 tanker trucks delivering 1.65 million liters of petroleum products to the northern city of Agadez as the country seeks to ease fuel shortages and strengthen energy cooperation with its northern neighbor. The convoy arrived on October 31, 2026, under military escort from both countries, according to Niger's state broadcaster RTN.

article_manifest.title: Massive influx of gold miners from Guinea: The Malian Government takes stock of the situation It was this Thursday, during a press briefing jointly hosted by the two ministers in the conference room of the Ministry of Security, that the details of this humanitarian and security crisis were shared with the
article_manifest.original_title: Afflux massif d’orpailleurs en provenance de Guinée : Le Gouvernement malien fait le point sur la situation C’est ce jeudi, au cours d’un point de presse animé conjointement par les deux ministres dans la salle de conférence du ministère de la Sécurité, que les détails de cette crise humanitaire et sécuritaire ont été partagés avec l’opinio
article_manifest.summary: Following a decision by the Guinean authorities banning traditional and illegal gold panning on their soil, Mali is facing an influx of migrants on an unprecedented scale. Nearly 80,000 people, mostly foreign nationals representing at least six nationalities, have crossed the border at Kourémalé since 2 November Faced with this critical situation that suddenly occurred, the Malian State immediately reacted under the aegis of the Prime Minister, Chairman of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management .

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Niafunké: Two kamikaze drones miss their targets, FAMa reaction welcomed
article_manifest.original_title: Niafunké : Deux drones kamikazes manquent leurs cibles, la réaction des FAMa saluée
article_manifest.summary: Niafunké, November 5 (AMAP)– Two kamikaze drones launched from the south of Niafunké, across the Niger River, in the direction of the city, missed their targets on Thursday. The incident resulted in a minor injury, immediately taken care of by the Defence and Security Forces (FDS), the AMAP learned from a security source . According to the information gathered, one of the machines fell into the rice fields of the Goubo rice field, while the second crashed into the concession of a resident, damaging his solar installations.

article_manifest.title: Koro, Sandaré and Sofara: Flood of fire on terrorists As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted airstrikes between 03 and 04 November 2026. These operations made it possible to target two bases of armed terrorist groups in different localities of our country.
article_manifest.original_title: Koro, Sandaré et Sofara : Déluge de feu sur les terroristes Dans le cadre de l’opération Dougoukoloko, les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa), appuyées par leurs partenaires, ont mené des frappes aériennes entre le 03 et le 04 novembre 2026. Ces opérations ont permis de cibler deux bases de groupes armés terroristes dans différentes localités de notre pays..
article_manifest.summary: According to the statement of the General Staff of the Armed Forces published this Thursday, the exploitation of precise intelligence on Tuesday, November 03, 2026 made it possible to locate, fifty-two (52) kilometers north-east of Koro, a base of armed terrorist groups housing several individuals as well as war equipment, including motorcycles and a fuel depot .

article_manifest.title: In the crisis in the Sahel, a voice is seriously lacking: that of black African intellectuals
article_manifest.original_title: Dans la crise au Sahel, une voix manque gravement : Celle des intellectuels noirs africains
article_manifest.summary: Image generated by AI In this forum devoted to the security and geopolitical crisis in the Sahel, Clément Roger Yaméogo, demographer-economist and head of the firm CERYA, challenges black African intellectuals on their weak involvement in reflection and mobilization around the issues of sovereignty and economic independence of the continent. It calls for a mobilization of scientific, academic and professional skills to better understand the drivers of the crisis, enlighten the populations and contribute to the construction of an Africa master of its resources and its destiny.

article_manifest.title: Mouhoun: The garrison of Dédougou commemorates the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces under the sign of sovereign defense
article_manifest.original_title: Mouhoun : La garnison de Dédougou commémore les 66 ans des Forces armées nationales sous le signe de la défense souveraine
article_manifest.summary: BURKINA-MOUHOUN-ARMEE-ANNIVERSAIRE-COMMEMORATION Mouhoun: The garrison of Dédougou commemorates the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces under the sign of sovereign defense Dédougou, Nov 1 . 2026 (AIB)-The garrison of Dédougou celebrated on Sunday, November 1, 2026, the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces (FAN) through a ceremony of taking up arms under the theme "National Armed Forces and military reserve for a sovereign defense of the Fatherland" .
